description: Replay how every captured screen and flow of a tday feature was reached (tday keeps the steps) on the current code, capturing new versions under the same keys. Start the dev server and seed the same demo data first. Replays that only look run first; one that changes the app's data (approving, deleting, sending) runs last, and any further ones are left pending: reset the demo data, then call again with those keys. Then capture_review and capture_upload as usual; tday shows what changed and which videos it affects.

keys.description: Only these screen or flow keys (to retry after resetting the demo data)

name: capture_recapture
title: Recapture a feature after a UI change
